tools.name: waist_check
tools.description: Use this when an adult asks whether their waist or belly size is too big or risky, such as "is 36 inch waist bad for a man", "waist 88 cm woman", "waist to height ratio 92 cm 170 cm" or "belly fat cutoff for Indians". Do not use for children, pregnancy, diagnosis of a disease, or treatment and medic

tools.name: waist_target
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what waist size is healthy for their height or sex, such as "healthy waist size for 5 ft 8 man", "ideal waist for 160 cm woman" or "what should my waist be". Gives half your height and the Indian cutoff. Do not use for children, pregnancy, or medical diagnosis.
